name: Berrocal de Huebra (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white above and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Berrocal de Huebra (chequy of red and yellow above a green mount and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Berrocal de Huebra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
